text: This report discusses the upcoming round of collective bargaining negotiations between Toronto Parking Authority and Toronto Parking Authority's Union TCEU Local 416.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the negotiation mandate with the Toronto Civic Employees' Union (TCEU) Local 416, as presented in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 1, Appendix 1 to the report (February 17, 2026) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 2. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 17, 2026) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 3. Directed that the information contained in the Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 1, Appendix 1 to the report (February 17, 2026) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in its entirety as it contains information pertaining to labour relations and employee negotiations.
